description: Money actually spent on a project. The expense list behind the budget. Import THIRTY-EIGHTH (needs user_projects)
notes: This is the record of what LEFT the account. An item (37) is what is planned; this is what happened. A budget that cannot tell those apart cannot answer 'have I spent it, or only promised it'.
item_id is optional and links a spend back to the thing it bought, so an item can show as paid for without duplicating the amount into two tables.
amount is positive. A refund is a negative amount, deliberately, so a single sum is always the truth and no reader has to know about a 'kind' column.
spent_at is a date, not a timestamp: nobody budgets to the minute, and a date sorts and groups without timezone argument.
category is free text. Every fixed list of building categories is wrong by the second job.

title.description: What it was for. Primary field

user_id.description: Xano user id as a string. EVERY read filters on this

task_id.description: Optional: the task it was spent on

item_id.description: Optional: the item it paid for

currency.description: ISO code. Blank means the project's own

category.description: materials, labour, tools, permits - free text on purpose
